content:
Owen Wilson's comedy Stick has drawn plenty of comparisons to Ted Lasso, and Apple has just announced it's coming back for a second season — with Rhea Seehorn from Pluribus joining the cast.

Stick season 2 premieres on November 4, with Rhea Seehorn joining the cast

After season 3 of Ted Lasso aired, no one knew if the show would ever come back. Luckily for Lasso fans, season 4 is now streaming.

But during that window, Apple TV released a new show that's remarkably similar to Lasso.

Owen Wilson's Stick was immediately compared to Ted Lasso when it premiered last summer — both are inspirational, feel-good sports comedies. Now, shortly after Ted Lasso wrapped up season 4, Stick is making its own return.

Stick season 2 will debut with its first two episodes on Wednesday, November 4, and will release new episodes weekly until December 30.

Here's a spoiler-free synopsis provided by Apple:

According to a press release from Apple, the new season will see Santi take steps toward a career in professional golf, while Pryce also returns to the sport.

Stick's strong cast will return for season 2, including, alongside Wilson, Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

Rhea Seehorn of Pluribus fame will join the cast as Pryce's new golf coach. Other new additions to the cast include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle.

You can catch up on Stick season 1 on Apple TV.

Are you a fan of Stick? Will you be tuning in for season 2? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, with discounts available through an Apple One bundle.
